question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Lose your marbles
solution: The correct answer is option 1), i.e., "To go insane." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: • The phrase 'Lose your marbles' means** '****to become crazy or mentally unstable.'** (मानसिक रूप से अस्थिर हो जाना) • *Example*: • *​**Ever since his retirement, he has started to **lose his marbles** and often forgets where he keeps his things.* • Hence, the only possible answer is option 1, 'To go insane,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase. 42:T88fc,
